profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Frontend Architect & Design Systems Lead | AI-Forward Engineering
profile.summary:
Staff-level frontend architect with 14+ years building scalable web applications, design systems, and component libraries across CRM, fintech, and SaaS platforms.

Currently at Luxury Presence, where I serve as the technical lead of the company's design system and primary frontend contributor to the CRM platform — the company's highest-priority product. I've shipped across 6 repositories spanning frontend, backend, mobile (React Native), AI platform, and infrastructure while leading a Radix-to-Base UI migration, authoring major technical proposals, and driving the design system from beta to general availability.

I'm deeply AI-forward: I was the first engineer at my company to adopt Claude Code, built AI agent features (Slack write capabilities, command palettes), and designed Claude Code validation skills used across repos. I believe the best engineering teams will be AI-augmented teams, and I'm actively shaping what that looks like in practice.

My career spans design system leadership at NCR Corporation (global enterprise scale), ground-up platform architecture at Haven (white-label fintech), and high-velocity product delivery at Trellis (promoted to Senior in 18 months). I care deeply about the space between design intent and engineering execution — building the right abstractions, establishing clear patterns, and creating tools that let teams ship faster without sacrificing quality.

Open to connecting with engineering leaders, founders, and anyone building at the intersection of frontend architecture and AI.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical lead of the company's design system at this Series C real estate technology platform serving 87,000+ agents (backed by Bessemer Venture Partners). Built the design system from scratch, delivered org-wide engineering training, authored the semantic token naming proposal (researching Material Design 3, GitHub Primer, Shopify Polaris, Adobe Spectrum), and led the Radix-to-Base UI migration — driving the system from beta toward general availability.

Primary frontend contributor to the CRM/Contacts platform — the company's highest-priority product — shipping navigation redesign, saved search flows, cross-list search, contact tagging, Jest-to-Vitest migration RFC, and back-end mutations. Ship at exceptional velocity across 6 repositories spanning frontend, backend, mobile (React Native), design system, AI platform, and infrastructure. Release approver across multiple codebases.

Drove the HST migration strategy pivot from component-level to page-level approach, authored the full ARM document, built 23 new compound components, and designed two Claude Code validation skills (/migration-check, /pr-guidelines-check).

Championed AI-forward engineering as the first engineer to adopt Claude Code. Built Auggie AI agent features including Slack write capabilities and a global command menu. Optimized Claude instructions across repositories.

Conduct Staff-level engineering interviews with a PRD-based structure evaluating AI proficiency and design system governance. Mentor new engineers on codebase architecture and onboard team members across CRM, design system, and mobile.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · Next.js · Tailwind CSS · GraphQL · TanStack

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led the ground-up architecture of a white label, multi-tenant mortgage servicing platform and worked closely with the UX team to build a component library and design system for the servicing platform. I wrote and executed upon many tech plans for refactors, new features, and net-new prototypes.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I owned the front-end of the Connect platform and ran experiments to constantly improve conversion rates. I also made several performance improvements, reducing the bundle size dramatically and saving the company thousands of dollars annually.

positions.description: Skills: Front-End Development · Next.js · TypeScript · Node.js · React.js · GraphQL · Tailwind CSS · Redux.js

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on an Agile team, building feature sets for medical providers using TDD methodologies.

positions.title: Senior UI Engineer
positions.description: Worked with the global design system team to establish a fully documented component library that could be used by any teams across the company.

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description: I am project lead / manager on any mobile applications that come to our company. Also, as a team lead, I'm responsible for making sure a group of individuals have any support they need to work efficiently on a daily basis. I create and manage Agile Scrum projects in JIRA, organizing anything from a small brochure site to a large, complex application. I am also a member of our Process Improvement Team (P.I.T.), working with a few others to improve our development process and workflow through our own ideas, as well as hearing others out.
